data.rationale: The proposal follows the same core procedure in the right order (Flights tab, origin, destination, date, Search, sort Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) with the key parameters origin, destination and date. It omits trip type (one-way or multi-city), passengers, filters and the second leg, and it skips the Done button, so it is slightly less general, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
